about: Budgets for cargo xtask perf (docs/performance.md). A run fails when a metric median over the measured runs exceeds its budget. Set 2026-10-12 from three passes x 3 runs (+1 warm-up) on a shared 8-core WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 machine (AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D, load average 6-27 from parallel builds), dev profile, git e00874e+wp/perf. Rule: timings max(4x median, 50 ms); UI frame medians max(4x median, 16.7 ms), except text-500 smooth scrolling which is held to the 60 fps target (16.7 ms); peak RSS 1.25x median (RSS varies <= 12% across runs, so 1.25x catches an extra copy of a large file). Values rounded up to two significant digits. text-5000 UI numbers encode a known defect (Comments panel cost grows with the comment count, docs/performance.md): the budget only stops it getting worse.

text-500._note: M3 500-page document; smooth scrolling median held to 60 fps

text-5000._note: scaling check; UI budgets record the Comments-panel defect. Engine RSS re-set 2026-10-12 (wp/hardening, one dev run) for the bounded automation text cache plus its search index: peak RSS 989 -> 484 MiB, find 167 -> 49 ms
